items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Britt Woodman and Buddy Collette brought him to me. They had heard me playing, and they liked the sound I got out of the instrument and the approach to it.

ctx.x: How did he happen to come to you?

Buddy Collette and Britt Woodman. Oh, there's some guy who's calling me all the time now; he wants to do a movie about Mingus. Anyhow, Britt Woodman and Buddy Collette brought him to me. They had heard me playing, and they liked the sound I got out of the instrument and the approach to it. Because my inspiration had been Duke Ellington, so naturally I was conscious of where the beat was, and the rhythm... Anyhow, they brought him to me, and I got him started and showed him how to approach it. And to prove that…
How old was Mingus? What year was this when he came to you?
